integrity: The topological and flag-complex input lemmas are attributed to the original primary paper, whose relevant proof text was inspected. No authorship, external audit, independent validation or mathematical uniqueness is claimed. Reproducibility checks use a standalone exact verifier; finite experiments are not treated as proof of the infinite theorem.
limitations: Even n>=4 only; exact rational reflection characters and rational homology of single-reflection quotients, not integral representation lattices or equivariant homotopy type. Previously established nonequivariant and even-rotation results are not new. In the n divisible by four case the reflection vanishing is already a consequence of the published rotational module.
title: Reflection characters and quotient homology of even Möbius-ladder perfect-matching complexes
